items.text: Kansas has no medical or adult-use cannabis. Possessing marijuana is a Class B misdemeanour for a first offence, a Class A misdemeanour for a second and a felony for a third or later (K.S.A. 21-5706). The only defence concerns a cannabidiol (CBD) treatment preparation held by someone with a debilitating condition, or their parent or guardian, who carries a letter from a Kansas-licensed physician dated within the past 15 months.

laws.rule: Kansas bans using a wireless device to write, send or read a text, instant message or email while driving on a public road (K.S.A. 8-15,111). Entering a number or name to make or receive a call, receiving navigation messages and emergency, traffic or weather alerts are allowed, as is texting when stopped off the travelled part of the road. The section doesn't ban hand-held voice calls.
